about_the_game:
Only Up: Snow Demo is an early preview of a single-player parkour experience where every step and every jump matters. This demo is designed for you to test the game’s core movement mechanics, difficulty structure, and atmosphere.

You start climbing from the beginning point: icy platforms, narrow surfaces, and slippery obstacles await you. If you act impatiently, you will fall — even in this demo, a single mistake can erase all your progress.

This demo is not the full version; the goal is to let you feel the challenge of the game.

✅ WHAT’S INCLUDED IN THE DEMO?

A limited section (the starting climb in the game)

Core parkour mechanics: jumping, grabbing, moving between platforms

Physics-based obstacles and slippery surfaces

5–10 minutes of gameplay (depending on skill)

❌ NOT INCLUDED IN THE DEMO (FULL VERSION ONLY)

The full route to the summit (much longer climb)

Environment transitions (city, tall structures, steel platforms)

Additional parkour variations and special areas

Secret paths, risk–reward routes

Global leaderboard (speed & climb times)

✦ KEY FEATURES (Demo + Full Game)

Challenging Single-Player Parkour — tests patience, reflexes, and focus.

Every Mistake Matters — no checkpoints, you restart when you fall.

Atmospheric Journey — climb from a quiet snowy start to high-risk heights.

Will you reach the summit? Or will the snow and ice send you back to the beginning?

The demo includes a limited section of the path — no matter how high you climb, a single mistake can send you all the way back to the beginning.
